fields: as a table: cols [process, what it controls, record you can inspect], rows (cells strings or {t, link}), nav, fold, fold_noun (phones only: desktop shows every station). Records split at ";".
best_for: RecordTrail sets the processes of a quality system as stations on one record trail, each station dropping the record sheet it leaves on a cord, the trail ending in a stack of sheets.
